Name: Starbound Valley
Author: jawsawn
Description:
This mod bridges the gate between two mods and adds the Starbound (also published by Chucklefish) crops into Stardew Valley using JsonAssets. 

Contains 19 New Crops and an unique tree. Not all crops are sold by Pierre. It makes use of Clint, Willy, Krobus, Marnie and Marlon. Also it has 22 cooking recipes which some of them are pretty useful for endgame.

Crop values are asigned after comparing the original Starbound crop values to SDV and fitting them in the norm. That by itself took me a whole day and half. Some crops have similar values (lower or better) to starfruit and pumpkin but for other seasons. 


And one last thing, most textures are from the original Starbound game and I not claim them as mine in any other way. I absolutely respect the artists and the art. They are fantastic and I thought they would fit in SDV in interesting ways. So full credits go to Starbound Art Team/Chucklefish for textures. 


I guarantee you that this mod will [b]change your gameplay. [/b]

I had to assign values to each existing seed/food so this mod has a fully complete spreadsheet values of where to buy seeds & seed prices. I will share it soon, until then have fun finding them.

Here is the official Spreadsheet:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VGaoUAT1z76o91Yj4xC-T3uFel8yr3Q4JLAct5wwjEE/edit?usp=sharing


[b]How to Install:[/b]
1-Install SMAPI.
2-Download JsonAssets mod/unzip it and put it in Mods folder.
3-Download SpaceCore mod/unzip it and put it in Mods folder.
4-Finally download this mod/unzip it and put it in your Mods folder. (not in the jsonassets folder)
